---
title: "Contact"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
---

Whether you're a researcher, a law enforcement professional, a journalist, or just curious, feel free to reach out.

```{=html}
<div class="contact-wrap">
  <form action="https://formspree.io/f/maqvjrrl" method="POST">
    <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New message from jackdjohncox.github.io">
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label class="form-label">Name</label>
      <input type="text" name="name" class="form-control" placeholder="Your name" required>
    </div>
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label class="form-label">Email</label>
      <input type="email" name="email" class="form-control" placeholder="your@email.com" required>
    </div>
    <div class="mb-3">
      <label class="form-label">Message</label>
      <textarea name="message" class="form-control" rows="6" placeholder="What's on your mind?" required></textarea>
    </div>
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-sage w-100">Send Message</button>
  </form>
</div>

```
